title: Pat Novak, for Hire
paragraphs: A dark, sharply written San Francisco detective series starring Jack Webb as waterfront operator Pat Novak, whose jobs repeatedly lead into murder, corruption, and clashes with Inspector Hellman.
San Francisco hard-boiled detective drama centered on waterfront operator Pat Novak. The frozen 26 objects represent 24 surviving historical programs plus two alternate-transfer objects.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Represented 1946 Jack Webb regional survivors (October 13, 1946 to November 24, 1946) on [[org|org.0d7b5c86680811cc|ABC Radio Network]], Represented 1947 Ben Morris regional survivors (August 3, 1947 to November 30, 1947) on [[org|org.0d7b5c86680811cc|ABC Radio Network]], and 1949 national ABC run (February 13, 1949 to June 25, 1949) on [[org|org.0d7b5c86680811cc|ABC Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include [[person|jack-webb|Jack Webb]] (performer), William P. Rousseau (producer, director, and performer), Basil Adlam (composer, conductor, and music), George Fenneman (announcer), Tudor Owen (performer), [[person|raymond-burr|Raymond Burr]] (performer and announcer), and Jack Lewis (performer).

Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.0d7b5c86680811cc|ABC Radio Network]], [[org|org.a3129b8eb67efa37|KECA]], [[org|org.4798d1172deaae2c|Armed Forces Radio Service]], and [[org|org.0207d811941f7fb5|KGO]].

The stories often return to San Francisco waterfront and dockside life, hard-boiled private investigation, murder and violent crime, deception, aliases and hidden identity, blackmail, corruption and coercion, and money, gambling and criminal schemes.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes KGO regional hard-boiled detective production, Jack Webb / Ben Morris / Jack Webb lead transition, 1949 national ABC run, and Collector numbering and alternate transfers.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|escape|Escape]], [[show|richard-diamond-private-detective|Richard Diamond, Private Detective]], [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]], [[show|the-whistler|The Whistler]], and [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]].
